newsitem.title: USA: Viisage Technology sees Q2 EPS $0.08.
newsitem.headline: Viisage Technology sees Q2 EPS $0.08.

text.p: Viisage Technology Inc said Monday that it expects to report second quarter revenues of about $8.5 million and net income of about $700,000, or $0.08 per share.
The company said revenues and earnings for the three months ended June 29 will reach record levels, but will be lower than analysts' estimates for the quarter.
Analysts had estimated the company would report earnings of $0.10 per share for the second quarter, according to First Call.
The company said the shortfalls are due primarily to delays in the timing of contract awards for certain projects, of the sort which can accompany large public sector capital expenditures.
The company said it will release second quarter results on July 22.
